mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_metadata ( uploader_user_id, team_id, original_name, stored_path, content_type, size_bytes, duration_seconds, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{uploaderUserId}, #{teamId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{originalName}, #{storedPath}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{durationSeconds,jdbcType=INTEGER}, 'ACTIVE', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT f.file_id AS fileId, f.uploader_user_id AS uploaderUserId, uploader.nickname AS uploaderNickname, uploader.email AS uploaderEmail, f.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, f.original_name AS originalName, f.stored_path AS storedPath, f.content_type AS contentType, f.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, f.duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, f.status, f.hold_reason AS holdReason, f.deleted_at AS deletedAt, f.physical_delete_due_at AS physicalDeleteDueAt, f.created_at AS createdAt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_item wi WHERE wi.file_id = f.file_id AND wi.status != 'DELETED' ) AS workReferenceCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_work_approval_request twr WHERE twr.file_id = f.file_id AND twr.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') ) AS requestReferenceCount FROM file_metadata f JOIN user_account uploader ON uploader.user_id = f.uploader_user_id LEFT JOIN team t ON t.team_id = f.team_id WHERE f.file_id = #{fileId}

SELECT f.file_id AS fileId, f.uploader_user_id AS uploaderUserId, f.team_id AS fileTeamId, f.status AS fileStatus, wi.work_id AS workId, wi.owner_user_id AS workOwnerUserId, wi.team_id AS workTeamId, wi.visibility AS workVisibility, wi.status AS workStatus, p.post_id AS postId, p.author_user_id AS postAuthorUserId, p.visibility AS postVisibility, p.status AS postStatus, p.deleted_at AS postDeletedAt, twr.request_id AS requestId, twr.requester_user_id AS requestUserId, twr.team_id AS requestTeamId, twr.status AS requestStatus FROM file_metadata f LEFT JOIN work_item wi ON wi.file_id = f.file_id AND wi.status = 'PUBLISHED' LEFT JOIN board_post p ON p.post_id = wi.board_post_id AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN team_work_approval_request twr ON twr.file_id = f.file_id AND twr.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') WHERE f.file_id = #{fileId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) AS totalBytes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activeCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN size_bytes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activeBytes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'HELD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS heldCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'HELD' THEN size_bytes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS heldBytes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DELETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deletedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DELETED' THEN size_bytes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deletedBytes FROM file_metadata

SELECT f.uploader_user_id AS userId, u.nickname, u.email, COUNT(*) AS fileCount, COALESCE(SUM(f.size_bytes), 0) AS activeBytes FROM file_metadata f JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = f.uploader_user_id WHERE f.status = 'ACTIVE' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY f.uploader_user_id, u.nickname, u.email ORDER BY activeBytes DESC, fileCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, COUNT(*) AS fileCount, COALESCE(SUM(f.size_bytes), 0) AS activeBytes FROM file_metadata f JOIN team t ON t.team_id = f.team_id WHERE f.team_id IS NOT NULL AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY f.team_id, t.name ORDER BY activeBytes DESC, fileCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_item wi WHERE wi.file_id = #{fileId} AND wi.status != 'DELETED' ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_work_approval_request twr WHERE twr.file_id = #{fileId} AND twr.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') )
mapper.update: UPDATE file_metadata SET status = 'DELETED', hold_reason = #{holdReason}, deleted_at = NOW(), physical_delete_due_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
UPDATE file_metadata SET status = 'HELD', hold_reason = #{holdReason}, deleted_at = NULL, physical_delete_due_at = NULL WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
UPDATE file_metadata SET status = 'ACTIVE', hold_reason = NULL, deleted_at = NULL, physical_delete_due_at = NULL WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) FROM file_metadata WHERE uploader_user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) FROM file_metadata WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
